values.note: $27-62 a night for an RV site, plus tax and a $5 reservation fee per site; B-loop sites are the cheapest ($27-34 most nights) and the premium A and C sites reach $62 on summer holiday weekends. The primitive tent-only D sites are $19-31. Every bookable night on the park's reservation calendar for eight two-week windows from 2026-11-26 to 2027-10-26, read 2026-11-25.

values.note: 126 water/electric RV sites in Areas A-C (49 pull-through) and 27 primitive tent sites in Area D, plus a group site. Every RV site but A39 (19 ft) takes a rig of 27 ft or more.

note:
Tennessee state park on a peninsula jutting into Chickamauga Lake.  RV sites along the lakeshore with direct water access and lake views.  --AWH
The primitive tent loop (Area D) is not sold in winter. --Claude
